nonlinear dimension reduction techniques outperform the linear ones, especially in case of limited number of training data, and that multi subject classification can be performed by aligning between subjects using dimension reduction techniques.

the diffusion maps outperformed the principal component analysis in case of limited number of training data samples and that the proposed multi subject classification algorithm, that utilized an alignment algorithm, enable robust classification of new subjects based on another subjects training data set.

the development of novel techniques for EMG processing and for EMG based classification of human hand movement.
developing a framework for EMG based human movement classification that is robust for single and multi subjects.
the development and application of novel machine learning techniques for the classification of hand movements based on the analysis of surface EMG signals.

the nonlinear dimensionality reduction techniques, in particular the diffusion maps, outperform the linear dimensionality techniques when applied for EMG based single subject hand classification, and the proposed multi subject classification algorithm, based on dimensionality reduction techniques along with data alignment, enable robust classification of new subjects based on another subjects data sets.
the nonlinear dimensionality reduction methods are more appropriate for EMG based hand movements classification than linear methods.

the nonlinear dimensionality reduction techniques are superior to the linear methods for single subject EMGs classification.

the proposed framework is a good candidate for real life applications, since it enables single subject classification based on limited training set size, and multi subject classification based on small amount of training data from a single subject.
